name: groundtruth
description: No build step for the app itself — this exists only to pin the Playwright version the browser tests need (so CI installs the same version a local run would) and the Node-side packages the golden tests use to extract real content back out of generated files: pdf-parse for tests/pdf/pdf_golden.js, and mammoth + jszip (body text and header/footer XML, respectively) for tests/docx/docx_golden.js.
